name: Brickyard Press
summary: A two-press letterpress shop in an old brickworks, printing wedding suites, business cards and posters by hand.
audience: couples planning a wedding and small businesses who want cards people keep

logo.clear_space: Clear space: a quarter of the logo's height on every side.
logo.min_size: Smallest: horizontal 320 px or 48 mm wide; the mark alone down to 16 px, 6 mm printed, 17 mm stitched.

colors.name: Cotton
colors.use: cards and panels on the page

colors.name: Press Black
colors.use: all body text and the wordmark

colors.name: Brick
colors.use: the mark, buttons, one word a page

type.license: Both from Google Fonts, free to use.

lines: We talk like printers at the counter: plain, warm, a little proud of the work.
We name the paper, the ink and the press; specifics beat adjectives.
We give the price and the wait up front, and never rush a couple.

examples.do: Printed on 600 gsm cotton, two colors, on the 1952 Heidelberg. Ready in three weeks.
examples.dont: Elevate your special day with our luxurious, bespoke stationery solutions!

examples.do: The proof is in your inbox. Mark anything you'd change and we'll set it again.
examples.dont: Please review the attached deliverable at your earliest convenience.

do: Real work on the real press, in window light
Close enough to see the bite of the type in the paper
Hands, tools and paper; the brick walls of the shop
dont: Stock flat-lays with eucalyptus and gold rings
Mockups pretending to be printed pieces
Filters that fake grain or age
